summary: All 24 existing candidates correspond to cell types outside the target_cell_scope (Cardiac neuron, Schwann cell, Neuroendocrine/Pulmonary neuroendocrine cell) and were excluded. Active full-text scan found no formal markers for any target cell type in the Markdown, so the corrected target-scope marker table is empty.

issues.description: All 24 existing candidate markers correspond to non-target cell types (B/plasma cells, T cells, hepatocytes, Kupffer cells, LSEC/liver endothelial cells, microglia) that are not included in target_cell_scope; none should enter the corrected target-scope marker table.
Active scan of the Markdown found no formal evidence for Cardiac neuron, Schwann cell, or Neuroendocrine/Pulmonary neuroendocrine cell markers; no target-scope markers are available from this paper.

task.paper_title: A single-cell transcriptomic atlas characterizes ageing tissues in the mouse.
task.target_cell_scope: L1:Cardiac neuron / L2:Schwann cell / L4:Neuroendocrine cell/Pulmonary neuroendocrine cell
